text:
When recessions arrive, theatres, design studios, publishers and film crews often lose customers first, and this essay will suggest practical measures that governments could take to support creative industries during economic downturns, focusing on emergency finance and on helping the sector to adapt.

To begin with, governments can protect creative industries with emergency funds, tax relief and commissions. Artists and studios rely on irregular income and discretionary spending, so grants, loans, public contracts and help with digital and foreign markets keep talent and skills alive. A theatre company that cannot sell tickets during a crisis, for example, can survive with a government grant that pays rent and wages until audiences return. Temporary reductions in sales tax and business charges leave more money in the sector, while loans on favourable terms prevent firms from collapsing. Governments can also commission murals, films, music and design for public buildings and campaigns, which gives work to many freelancers.

In addition, authorities should help the sector to adapt and to grow. Training in digital skills allows creators to sell online, and export agencies can help studios to reach foreign markets where demand may be stronger. Shared workspaces at low rent and funds for new ideas encourage start-ups, and income support for self-employed artists prevents them from leaving the profession. Equally important, protecting copyright ensures that creators are paid when their work is used. The sector recovers faster and contributes to growth, since creative industries employ many people and attract tourists, and a recession is a time to preserve skills that would take years to rebuild.

In conclusion, emergency finance together with support for adaptation and export offers the most realistic way to protect creative industries in a downturn.

analysis.type_vi: Solutions: hỗ trợ ngành sáng tạo khi suy thoái

plan.think: Mở bài nêu nhà hát, studio, nhà xuất bản, đoàn phim mất khách đầu tiên; hai nhóm: tài chính khẩn cấp; giúp thích nghi.

Quỹ khẩn cấp, giảm thuế, đặt hàng: nghệ sĩ thu nhập thất thường, chi tiêu tuỳ ý nên trợ cấp, vay, hợp đồng công, hỗ trợ số, thị trường nước ngoài giữ tài năng; ví dụ đoàn kịch không bán vé trong khủng hoảng sống nhờ trợ cấp trả thuê, lương đến khi khán giả trở lại; giảm thuế bán hàng tạm thời, phí kinh doanh; vay ưu đãi; đặt tranh tường, phim, nhạc, thiết kế cho công trình, chiến dịch công.

Giúp thích nghi, tăng trưởng: đào tạo kỹ năng số bán online; cơ quan xuất khẩu giúp studio ra thị trường nước ngoài; không gian chung thuê thấp, quỹ ý tưởng; hỗ trợ thu nhập nghệ sĩ tự do; bảo vệ bản quyền; ngành phục hồi nhanh, tạo nhiều việc, thu hút du lịch; bảo tồn kỹ năng.
Tài chính khẩn cấp, hỗ trợ thích nghi và xuất khẩu.
